facts.fact: The BCEAO list of payment institutions licensed under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA shows licences issued under it, so the instruction was in force at 31 August 2026.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list names 11 payment institutions licensed in Senegal under Instruction n°001-01-2024 at 31 August 2026, including Dunya Digital Payment Sénégal, Flutterwave Sénégal and Julaya Sénégal, licensed between May and September 2025.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA
